articles.title: NASA Spins Mars Helicopter Blades Faster Than Sound
articles.summary: NASA tested new Mars helicopter blades at supersonic speeds, a step toward future aircraft that can carry heavier science gear.

articles.title: The Mystery of 8,000 Ancient Frogs — Solved by Owls
articles.summary: Archaeologists traced 8,000 Roman-era frog bones in a Cambridgeshire ditch to a feast by short-eared owls.

articles.title: Paper Rockets: Why Fins Keep Them Flying Straight
articles.summary: A straw-launched paper rocket experiment shows how fins keep a rocket flying straight instead of spinning out of control.
